segments.name: investment management
segments.description: Externally managed BDC that invests primarily in directly originated first lien senior secured loans to private U.S. middle-market companies.
segments.evidence: The Company operates under one operating segment and reporting unit, investment management.

revenueModel.text: Portfolio companies borrowing from the company pay it loan income, plus upfront fees, call premiums, and equity or warrant income.
revenueModel.evidence: Additional income can be generated from upfront fees, call protections including call premiums, equity co-investments or warrants.
